# Verbs

Every action a person can take has a `type`, handled by a verb registered with `defineVerbs()`
in `public/src/actions/verbs/`. Unknown types fall back to `default`.

## basic.js

Everyday verbs: moving, eating, sleeping, playing, studying.

`move`, `eat`, `eatOwn`, `drink`, `sleep`, `do`, `study`, `selfCure`, `leave`, `settle`, `mourn`, `play`, `chooseRole`, `default`, `wait`

## social.js

Social verbs: talking, requests, gifts, relationships.

`say`, `request`, `respond`, `give`, `repay`, `breakup`, `voice`, `keepPromise`, `adopt`, `divorce`

## work.js

Work verbs: gathering, building, running a business, trading.

`gather`, `build`, `sell`, `buy`, `buyBiz`, `produce`, `stock`, `collect`, `prices`, `quit`, `fire`, `treat`, `repair`

## civic.js

Civic verbs: problems, laws, elections, the ruins, inventions.

`problem`, `decree`, `repeal`, `election`, `punish`, `fund`, `charity`, `openDoor`, `reseal`, `invented`, `meeting`

## crime.js

Crime verbs: fights, theft, robbery.

`fight`, `steal`, `robBiz`
